body: 8-K filed 23-Nov-2026 (Item 5.02): on 22-Nov the board reinstated Huang as President, CEO and board member effective immediately; Kress stays EVP & CFO; Harvey C. Jones remains chair. Ex-99.1: unanimous vote after the board was 'satisfied with respect to Mr. Huang's candor'; board 'received input from senior levels of the United States government' that reinstatement 'poses no national security risk'. Independent-director committee investigation (into reporting that Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort) 'will proceed to conclusion'; new National Security and Export Control Committee; Chief Compliance Officer search; company 'will continue to cooperate with ongoing government investigations and inquiries'. Sequel to event:US-NVDA:ceo-resignation-2026-11. Reported SEC disclosure probe (WSJ ~17-Nov) and California AG subpoena (~19-Nov) are press-reported only (verdict partly). Q3 FY27 10-Q not on EDGAR as of 26-Nov-2026.

data.sec_probe: reported (WSJ via PYMNTS/InvestmentNews), disclosure focus; unconfirmed by SEC/NVDA

title: NVIDIA board reinstates Jensen Huang as President, CEO and director (22-Nov-2026), 11 days after accepting his resignation
